content:
Noticing anything weird on X this morning? It’s not just you. Parts of the service are experiencing downtime this morning, it appears.

Users report issues like being signed out of accounts, profiles showing no posts, and general unavailability when loading the website or app.

The outage is likely a temporary blip that will be resolved quickly. If you’re noticing any weirdness with loading the X app or site today, however, it’s not just you. No need to troubleshoot on your end.

Downdetector similarly shows issues with Reddit, Zoom, and Fortnite, among other services. This suggests the disruption is not something specific to the X service.

While X is where we first noticed the issue, Cloudflare and Amazon Web Services being on Downdetector’s list of affected services might point to the cause here.

Have you noticed any issues loading X or any other services this morning?
